_comment: Example. Employer job boards are personal: add them with `python -m fitly probe "Company" --add`, which saves the list in config/local/ats_sources.json (never versioned). Format of an employer entry: {"type": "lever", "site_name": "acme", "company": "Acme"} (greenhouse: "board_token"; teamtailor, recruitee, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable: "site_name" or "board").

sources._cle: SERPAPI_KEY (100 recherches/mois gratuites, serpapi.com) — 3 recherches par collecte max
sources._rotation: 3 recherches par collecte, en commençant chaque jour par un mot-clé différent
